description: Single-rater (Claude, during M5) strict re-grade of the 15 chat_v1 'qa' items. A reply counts as correct only if it states the right answer as its answer, without contradicting it. The automatic include_any check is lenient (substring matches such as '7' inside '57', or the right word inside unrelated text) and is reported alongside as an upper bound. Borderline replies are listed and counted as incorrect.
rule: states the correct answer as the answer to the question; no self-contradiction; incidental mentions do not count
